def transform(grid):
    # Extract central 4x4 tile of the recurring symmetric pattern? Locate 8 marker block as locator.
    # The 30x30 canvas consists of symmetric background pattern and a 8 patch overlaid; output is the region under patch removed.
    # Identify marker 8 bounding box and return the corresponding opposite patch (mirrored position) in grid.
    pos=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v==8]
    r0=min(r for r,c in pos); r1=max(r for r,c in pos); c0=min(c for r,c in pos); c1=max(c for r,c in pos)
    # output region is a repeated motif from opposite symmetrical location across the 30x30 central symmetry
    h,w=r1-r0+1,c1-c0+1
    # marker block replaces area; recover by rotational symmetry around grid center
    return [[grid[29-r][29-c] for c in range(c0,c1+1)] for r in range(r0,r1+1)]
PY
